senses.gloss: स्थु. See दुः-ष्ठु and सु-ष्ठु॑.
स्थू (collateral of √ 1. स्था, formed to account for the words below), prob. ‘to be thick or solid or strong’.
स्थुड् (= √ थुड्) cl. 6. P. स्थुडति, to cover, Dhātup. xxviii, 94.
1. स्थुल n. (perhaps for स्थुड See prec.) a sort of long tent, Śiś.
